millsage · 重逢的间隙
An unofficial fan-made interactive experience.

Game characters, artwork, models, textures and animations:
BanG Dream! Our Notes — © BanG Dream! Project © FROMTOKYO © bushiroad.
Official project: https://bang-dream.com/artist/millsage/

Public resource archive and web renderers:
OtoNote — https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/
Source: https://github.com/stonesver/otonote
MIT license: assets/OTONOTE-LICENSE.txt
Scene sources and bundled library licenses: assets/immersive/SOURCES.txt
Three.js license: assets/immersive/THREE-LICENSE.txt
Spine runtime license: assets/immersive/SPINE-RUNTIME-LICENSE.txt

Original garage scenes: 40001 (Kanata), 40002 (Hotaru).
These use original game Spine home_start animation data and scene geometry.
The browser replays the original clips; page transitions and synchronized
portrait breathing/blinking are authored separately for this experience.

Live2D Cubism Core: https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-proprietary-software-license-agreement_en.html
Cubism SDK: https://www.live2d.com/sdk/license/
